infographic.title: Choosing a Ball Valve Design
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four steps to choose between a floating and a trunnion mounted ball valve
steps: Small bore and low to medium class point to floating.
Double block and bleed needs a trunnion design.
High pressure raises floating torque; trunnion stays steadier.
Floating costs less; trunnion pays back in severe service.
